PullRequest.Title: Copilot setup: say that Install now also adds copilot to PATH
PullRequest.Body:

Part of microsoft/vscode-internalbacklog#7531. Fixes microsoft/vscode-internalbacklog#9996.

On the Windows setup's **GitHub Copilot CLI** page, only the "when I first run copilot" option said "Adds copilot to PATH", so **Install now** read as if it didn't add `copilot` to PATH.

### Changes
- **Wording:** every option's description now starts with what it does to PATH, and Ready to Install says the same. Option labels are unchanged.

  | Option | Description | Ready to Install |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | Install GitHub Copilot CLI now | Adds copilot to PATH and downloads about N MB from GitHub after VS Code is installed. | Add copilot to PATH and install now (about N MB download) |
  | Install GitHub Copilot CLI when I first run copilot | Adds copilot to PATH. Nothing is downloaded until you run it and confirm. (unchanged) | Add copilot to PATH |
  | Don't add the copilot command | copilot isn't added to PATH. You can still run it in the VS Code terminal. | Don't add copilot to PATH |

  The two-option pages (offline, and the System Installer) use the same wording for their options.
- **Behavior:** after **Install now** installs Copilot CLI, setup also adds VS Code's `copilot` command (`<VS Code>\bin\copilot-shim`) to PATH. Before, it did that only when the install failed. Both install options now end the same way: day to day `copilot` runs Copilot CLI, and if Copilot CLI is uninstalled later, `copilot` offers to install it again instead of disappearing outside VS Code. `REQUIREMENTS.md` says so.

### How to test
1. Run the User Installer with Copilot CLI not installed. The **GitHub Copilot CLI** page and **Ready to Install** show the wording above.
2. Choose **Install now** and finish setup. In a new terminal, `where.exe copilot` lists `%LOCALAPPDATA%\GitHubCopilotCLI\copilot.exe` and `<VS Code>\bin\copilot-shim\copilot.exe`.
3. Uninstall GitHub Copilot CLI from **Settings > Apps**. In a new terminal, `copilot` offers to install it again.

### Validation
- ISCC compile of the user and system x64 installers with the Copilot shim: passed.
- Installer Pascal harness: 90 of 90 passed.
- Stub user installer driven with UI Automation: the page shows the three new descriptions, and Ready to Install shows the matching line for each option: passed.
- Not run: a successful **Install now** (step 2), because it installs Copilot CLI on the machine; the System Installer's page, which needs elevation.

Scenarios.Scenario: Interactive User Installer: choose “Install GitHub Copilot CLI now” and installation succeeds
Scenarios.CriticalPath: After VS Code files are installed, CopilotPostInstall synchronously waits for the existing shim install process and its network/MSI work, then the changed code calls CopilotAddToPath before the finished page can proceed. The added PATH work is on the completion critical path but consists of bounded registry reads, a linear scan of the finite PATH string, and at most one registry write.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Launch the extracted copilot shim to download, verify, and install Copilot CLI.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One subprocess per explicit Install-now installer action.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same subprocess and wait were already performed before the PR.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The installer waits for its result before post-install completion.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Resolve/download Copilot CLI as performed by the child shim.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One logical install attempt, with download behavior owned by the existing shim command.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Install now already performed the same network-backed installation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Network/download completion is on the existing Install-now critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Poll progress/result INI files and cancellation state while the shim runs.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One set of files per installer run; progress/result checks repeat every 100 ms until completion or existing timeout bounds.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same polling loop existed before the PR.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Polling accompanies the existing synchronous wait for installation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Read machine/user PATH registry values, scan for the shim directory, and write one PATH value if absent.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One helper invocation after a successful Install-now action; up to three registry reads and at most one write. Work scales linearly with the bounded PATH string, not with files or users.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: On successful installation, the code only set CopilotCommandReady and skipped PATH registry work; on failed installation it already invoked this same helper.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Adds a small synchronous step before installer completion.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: The only scaling input for the new work is the number/length of entries in the current machine or user PATH, whose combined size is explicitly checked against the 32,767-character limit. The invocation cardinality is one per explicit successful installer action.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The install subprocess is one serialized attempt. Progress/result filesystem polling is serialized at 100 ms intervals. The added PATH registry operation runs once after that process completes; there is no per-item parallelism, queue, or concurrency burst.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: There is no cache. Warm behavior is idempotent: if the shim directory is already present, CopilotAddToPath exits after one PATH read and scan without writing. Cold behavior performs one bounded append/write.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence in the new once-per-success registry work and its position on the installer completion path; high confidence that it has no collection or concurrency fan-out.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact registry latency and typical PATH length vary by machine, but the operation is bounded and dominated by the pre-existing download/MSI install. No realistic multiplicative trigger was found.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The PR intentionally adds one bounded, idempotent PATH update after an already expensive explicit install, with no realistic repeated or scaling mechanism.

Scenarios.Scenario: Install-now fails or is cancelled, including silent explicit /copilotcli=install
Scenarios.CriticalPath: CopilotPostInstall waits for the same existing shim subprocess. The changed control flow still invokes CopilotAddToPath after failure/cancellation, as the pre-diff else branch did, then returns to installer completion. Silent success newly gets the same single PATH update as interactive success.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Attempt Copilot CLI installation through the shim.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One process per explicit install action.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Identical install invocation and timeout behavior.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Existing blocking installer work; bounded by start, stall, total, and cancellation timeouts.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Read progress/result files and optionally write the cancel file.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Repeated 100 ms polling for one install attempt, bounded by existing timeout constants.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Existing wait mechanism for install outcome.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Inspect and possibly update the registry PATH for the shim.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One invocation for the failed/cancelled action.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The old failure branch already called CopilotAddToPath once, including when cancellation made Installed false.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Small synchronous PATH step before completion.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One explicit install action and one bounded PATH string. Poll count depends on existing install duration/timeouts, not the diff.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One serialized shim install attempt followed by one serialized PATH helper call; no fan-out or aggregate burst.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache; existing idempotent containment check avoids a registry write when PATH already includes the shim. Failures are not retried by this changed code.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence from direct before/after branch comparison.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Install/network duration varies, but the PR does not increase those costs or the failure-path boundary count.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Failure and cancellation preserve the prior PATH-work cardinality, and silent success adds only the same bounded once-per-run update.

Scenarios.Scenario: Installer Copilot option page and Ready-to-Install summary display
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The changed English message values are formatted into already-existing static controls and memo text during page construction/navigation. No changed subprocess, IPC, filesystem, database, network, serialization, or layout-triggering loop is introduced.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: A fixed number of option descriptions and one summary line, independent of repository, installation size, or user data.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Single installer UI thread; each changed string is assigned once when its existing page or memo is built.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Existing page-built flags prevent repeated construction; changing string contents does not alter cache keys or invalidation.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence that the diff changes only fixed static message contents on this path.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Text measurement cost can vary slightly with DPI/font, but cardinality is fixed and the wording change does not establish a meaningful rendering regression.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Fixed wording changes do not add a hot/scaling rendering or boundary mechanism.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all three changed files and all diff pages. The only behavioral delta is one bounded, idempotent PATH registry operation after successful Install-now; existing network, subprocess, MSI, and filesystem polling behavior is unchanged, and failure/cancellation already performed the same PATH update. No high-confidence actionable performance regression or qualifying regression fix was found.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
